Interface NbtAdapter

All Known Implementing Classes:
PaperNbtAdapter
public interface NbtAdapter
An abstraction over Bukkit's PersistentDataContainer for reading and writing custom NBT data on items.

This adapter ensures that modifier code never directly depends on the underlying PDC implementation, enabling easier testing and future-proofing.

String-based keys are automatically resolved to NamespacedKey instances. Keys without a namespace prefix default to minecraft:.
